channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Watch: Hayes hat-trick sends Barrs towards Munster club SFC final date with Dingle
item.description: St Finbarr's will meet Dingle in the Munster club senior football championship final after brushing aside Éire Óg Ennis at SuperValu Pairc Ui Chaoimh this afternoon.

item.title: Newbridge-Scotstown Ulster semi-final abandoned after half-time pitch inspection
item.description: This afternoon's Ulster club SFC semi-final between Newbridge (Derry) and Scotstown (Monaghan) at O'Neills Healy Park has been abandoned at half-time due to adverse weather conditions.

item.title: Sunday's senior club championship results
item.description: Check out this afternoon's provincial senior club football and hurling championship results below...

item.title: O'Connor relishing maiden Leinster final
item.description: Rory O'Connor was already turning his thoughts to the Leinster club SHC final against Ballyhale Shamrocks at Croke Park on December 6 after St Martin's eased past Naas at Chadwicks Wexford Park.

item.title: Hyland bows out after Ballyhale defeat
item.description: Willie Hyland stepped down as Clough/Ballacolla manager following yesterday's narrow Leinster club SHC semi-final loss to Ballyhale Shamrocks.

item.title: Ulster GAA stands over abandonment call as Scotstown hit out
item.description: Ulster GAA president Michael Geoghegan has backed referee Joe McQuillan's decision to abandon yesterday's Ulster club SFC semi-final between Scotstown and Newbridge at half-time due to a waterlogged pitch.

item.title: Dingle boss sees room for improvement
item.description: Dingle manager Padraig Corcoran wasn't gettting carried away with his side's 2-15 to 0-2 Munster club SFC semi-final mauling of an understrength Mungret St Paul's.

item.title: Athletic Grounds to host re-fixture as Ulster club SFC final is pushed back
item.description: The BOX-IT Athletic Grounds will host the Ulster club SFC semi-final re-fixture between Scotstown and Newbridge next Sunday at 4pm.

item.title: The Championship 2025 by Brian Carthy is out now
item.description: Gaelic Games commentator, journalist and author, Brian Carthy reflects on the 2025 Football and Hurling Championships in his comprehensive book, which contains the results of every single game in both senior codes.

item.title: 'He'd be on any inter-county panel'
item.description: Jimmy Barry-Murphy was singing Brian Hayes' praises after his five-star display for St Finbarr's against Éire Óg, Ennis.
